title: metadax.org-declaration/0.1
description: An organisation's declaration of what stays inside its wall and what may leave via the outward gate.

default_visibility.description: What new nodes default to inside this org. 'private' = stays in; 'pending_review' = queued for export review.

private_module_ids.description: Module IDs that are wholly private. Any node whose module_id matches is blocked.

private_node_ids.description: Specific node IDs that are private, even if they live in an otherwise public module.

private_terms.description: Exact terms (case-sensitive substrings) that mark content as private. A node containing any of these in its text fields is blocked.

export_requires_review.description: If true, a node that otherwise passes the gate still needs an explicit review flag before export.

reviewers.description: Creator IDs authorised to approve nodes for export.
